tickets.title: Assemble tax filing data
tickets.text: Assemble the tax filing data for Dahlia Mossbutton and Owen Cloudpuddle, including year‑to‑date pay statements, equity vesting records, mortgage interest information for both properties, and condominium rental income, to support their first post‑marriage tax return.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to assemble that tax filing data by 2023-11-21.

tickets.title: Begin household contact info review

tickets.title: Liquidity Reserve Snapshot

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review the joint cash reserve target by 2023-11-17.

tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps
tickets.text: Request Dahlia Mossbutton's current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation. Gather her 2018 will, health care directive, and any other documents that list Lina Mossbutton as fiduciary.

subTasks.title: Request and log estate documents
subTasks.text: Send the standard document request checklist to the client and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.

subTasks.title: Review completeness and role information
subTasks.text: Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor gap summary
subTasks.text: Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow-up items for the lead advisor before any client-facing recommendations are discussed.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to collect those estate document copies by 2023-11-10.
